purpose: Build the durable item-level rights-qualified pre-1700 PDM/open registry, then preserve all 25 IIIF pages of the Johnson Papyrus as a bounded full-item smoke with hashes, provenance, canonical Google Drive writes, and exact Drive readback before any full-corpus expansion.

constraints.rights: Per-item Public Domain Mark (license id=pdm) and open-access location are both required and rechecked at retrieval time.
constraints.retrieval: Anonymous official Wellcome Catalogue API and IIIF only; never bypass login, CAPTCHA, paywall, robots, rate limits, or access controls.
constraints.compute: Standard GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest only; no paid, larger, GPU, VM, Colab, Replit agent, or external paid API.
constraints.preservation: Save raw metadata and manifest, every intended IIIF page, per-file SHA256/MD5, page index, resumable checkpoint, COMPLETE marker, and exact Google Drive size/MD5/JSON readback.
constraints.scaling: Do not launch a full-corpus rescue until this bounded full-item smoke passes end to end.
